newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA DRAGS THIN HELSINKI, UPM BUCKS TREND.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA DRAGS THIN HELSINKI, UPM BUCKS TREND.

text.p: * Shares fall by Thursday midsession in a correction to
Wednesday's sharp rise, but trade was thin. UPM bucks trend to
extend gains and touches a new 132.50 intraday life-high.
Shares fell on Thursday after
Wall Street fell overnight and Nokia pared gains which had
lifted it well into life-high ground on Wednesday, brokers said.
Focus was on the U.S. for direction, and brokers said they
were eyeing the S&P 500 index futures for an early hint
of Thursday's sentiment on Wall Street.
Nokia traded at 424.00 markka, down six, just above its U.S.
close which corresponded to about 423.5 markka. SBC Warburg said
the share had become expensive and downgraded it to a reduce
from hold.
Forestry major UPM-Kymmene held up well, setting a new
132.50 markka intra-day record -- and some brokers said there
seemed to be continued foreign interest in the share after
recommendations on International Paper were mixed after it
announced restructuring and closure plans.
"It seems there were more positive recommendations than
negative (on International Paper)," one broker said.
